native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 'after initialization', 'state': {'sevseg1': '0', 'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, the 7-segment display shows 0, and both servos are at 0°.'}

test2: {'time': 'after first button press', 'state': {'sevseg1': '1', 'servo1': '90°', 'servo2': '90°'}, 'description': 'First button press. The display increments to 1 (odd), so both servos move to 90°.'}

test3: {'time': 'after second button press', 'state': {'sevseg1': '2', 'servo1': '0°', 'servo2': '0°'}, 'description': 'Second button press. The display increments to 2 (even), so both servos move to 0°.'}

test4: {'time': 'after third button press', 'state': {'sevseg1': '3', 'servo1': '90°', 'servo2': '90°'}, 'description': 'Third button press. The display increments to 3 (odd), so both servos move to 90°.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
